sources.label: Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) 2017 Part 1, Article 2.50 — Grounding and Bonding
sources.description: Defines grounding vs. bonding, system grounding requirements, equipment grounding conductor sizing, and ground resistance standards (25 ohms max).

sources.label: PEC 2017, Section 2.50.2 — Grounding Electrode System
sources.description: Specifies grounding electrode types (ground rod, concrete-encased, building steel), installation requirements, and resistance standards.

sources.label: PEC 2017, Section 2.50.4 — Equipment Bonding
sources.description: Defines bonding requirements for non-current-carrying metal parts to prevent shock hazards and provide effective ground-fault paths.
